decision.title: Viva Las Vegas
tracklist: If You Think I Don't Need You
I Need Somebody to Lean On

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (4 tracks) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Viva_Las_Vegas_(EP), https://www.discogs.com/release/14635759-Elvis-Presley-%E3%83%A9%E3%82%B9%E3%83%99%E3%82%AC%E3%82%B9%E4%B8%87%E6%89%8D-Viva-Las-Vegas. VERIFIED: no full soundtrack LP was issued in 1964. The only official 1964 release was this 4-track EP (RCA Victor EPA-4382, May 1964, coincided with the film premiere). The 12-track 'soundtrack album' (Viva Las Vegas, What'd I Say, If You Think I Don't Need You, I Need Somebody to Lean On, C'mon Everybody, Today Tomorrow and Forever, Night Life, Santa Lucia, Do the Vega, You're the Boss, The Yellow Rose of Texas/The Eyes of Texas, The Lady Loves Me) is a later compilation (2003 FTD / 2010 Legacy), NOT a 1964 release.
